values.zh-CN: 非直谓命题类型消去子

values.en: This entry names the elimination principle associated with an impredicative proposition sort. Its exact type is system-dependent: elimination into Prop is generally available, while elimination into data-bearing Type universes is restricted, with only system-specific empty or singleton-like exceptions. No unrestricted recursor into Type is asserted here.
values.zh-CN: 本条目指称与非直谓命题 sort 相联系的消去原则。其确切类型取决于具体系统：通常可以消去到 Prop，而消去到携带数据的 Type 宇宙会受到限制，仅可能存在依系统而定的空命题或近似单构造子例外。此处不主张存在可无条件消去到 Type 的递归子。
